name: U.S. Insurance Industry Overview
description: This presentation profiles the late-1990s U.S. insurance industry for Software AG's North American middleware business, combining market sizing, business drivers, industry trends, and an insurance claims architecture example. It argues that insurance offers a large but demanding opportunity for SAGA SOM because insurers face disintermediation, e-commerce, Y2K, and data-management pressures while remaining skeptical of immature middleware and new suppliers. Prepared circa 1998, the deck also proposes partner categories spanning insurance ISVs and integrators.

creator.name: Peter S. Kastner (Chief Research Officer, Aberdeen Group)
